name: 92610 · Foothill Rnch, CA
findings: ZIP 92610 (Foothill Rnch) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92610 (Foothill Rnch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
